speciesBoardPreflight.renderingAuthority: VA01 + VA02 Face Grammar + accepted Human Board board/rendering grammar

fine portrait linework replacing bold hand-drawn contours
new infographic panels/turnarounds/headshot grids not present in the accepted Human Board
nonHumanAnatomySourceRule: Never derive non-Human anatomy from the accepted Human Board. The Human Board controls board/layout/rendering behavior only.
